# File Operation
Reads or writes a text file on the server.
## When to use
- A step needs to load a file's text or save generated text to disk.
## How it works
1. Requires `filepath`, and `fileoperationtype` set to `read` or `write`. 2. read: returns the file's content. 3. write: writes `filecontent`, creating parent folders and appending if `appendcontent` is true. 4. Records the status, then runs the children.
## Inputs
- `filepath`: Full path of the file - `fileoperationtype`: read or write - `filecontent`: Text to write (write only) - `appendcontent`: true to append instead of overwrite (write only)
## Outputs
- `fileoperationstatus`, `fileoperationresult`, `fileoperationdate`, `filepath`, `errormessage`
## Implementation
- Bean `fileOperationSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.FileOperationSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`
